name: migration-assistant.settings
title: Migration Assistant Settings
description: The declaration to configure Migration Assistant settings.

payloadkeys.title: Should do managed migration
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the device manages Migration Assistant.

payloadkeys.title: Excluded accounts
payloadkeys.content: An array of strings that represent the user account short names the system excludes from migration.

payloadkeys.title: Excluded paths
payloadkeys.content: An array of strings that represent files and directories relative to the user's home directory that the system excludes from migration. Directory paths need to include a trailing "/". For example, to exclude the "Excluded" directory in the "Documents" folder of a user's home directory, use "Documents/Excluded/".

payloadkeys.title: Required paths
payloadkeys.content: An array of strings that represent files and directories relative to the user's home directory that the system needs to migrate. Directory paths need to include a trailing "/". For example, to require the "Required" directory in the "Documents" folder of a user's home directory, use "Documents/Required/".

payloadkeys.title: Should migrate security privacy settings
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the system migrates Security & Privacy settings.
